cases.business_problem: Customers need advice and product recommendations expressed in terms of their project rather than a search keyword.
cases.business_context: Magic Apron on Home Depot digital platforms.

cases.business_context: Customer support across SMS, chat and phone, separate from DIY project advice.

cases.business_context: Wealth management advisor teams using AI at Morgan Stanley Assistant.

cases.target_task: Summarize client meetings and prepare follow-ups
cases.business_context: Consent-based Zoom client meetings reviewed by advisors.

cases.business_context: Onkata manages FyterTech advertising and obtains brand approval.

cases.business_problem: Global creatives do not fit local audiences and refreshing visuals takes up to a month.
cases.business_context: Hisense Mexico always-on campaigns, later extended to seven business lines.

cases.business_problem: Manual underbody inspection must locate metal deposits that can damage cables.
cases.target_task: Detect weld splatter on vehicle underbodies
cases.business_context: Neckarsulm body shop series production as described in May 2025.

cases.business_problem: Manual box unloading is strenuous and constrained by labor availability.
cases.target_task: Unload cartons from trailers onto conveyors
cases.business_context: First commercial Stretch deployment in January 2023.

cases.business_problem: Plant trips and labor-intensive analysis of many parameters impede reliable operation.
cases.target_task: Detect equipment failure risks for preventive maintenance

cases.business_problem: Broad-coverage spraying wastes herbicide and exposes healthy crops.
cases.target_task: Apply herbicide only where weeds are detected
